Commentary.Commentary: 230 to win. Do Zimbabwe stand a chance? Looking at their squad and the way Australia bowled yesterday, NO. But just for the sake of cricket, let us hope they show some fight and get as close as possible to the Aussie total. A victory would be an icing on the cake. The resumption should not be far...

Okay. Aaron Finch has taken some time out to have a word with Alistair Campbell. Says that the wicket played a lot better than the Aussies thought it would initially. Adds that he knew Gayle's record was 175 and feels that had he taken a couple of extra 2s, he could have broken it. But smiles the next moment and says that the UNIVERSE BOSS deserves it. Remembers that match very well because he was the opposition captain in that game when Chris Gayle smashed 175 for Bangalore against Pune! Praises Short for showing a lot of patience and feels that when the tournament reaches its dying stages and the wicket becomes slow, Short's innings like these will help him a lot.

One positive from this game for Zimbabwe is that they conceded only 45 from the last 4 overs, of which one single over went for 21. In an innings full of carnage, there was another positive for the bowling side - Tendai Chisoro finished with figures of 4-0-19-0 consisting of 11 dots - in an innings where only 31 were bowled in total. Muzarabani finished with 2 wickets and had better figures as compared to the rest.

Nothing much Zimbabwe could have done today except take some catches. They took one catch and dropped 5 - the latter being all of Aaron Finch. He was just looking to bash the ball, sans any feet movement or technique. Well, it simply was his day, wasn't it?

Well... Finch Finch Finch... has lynched Zimbabwe. 172 from just 76 balls - 16 fours and 10 sixes. Short played a supportive role, making 46 in a partnership of 223. Takes real strength to play that sort of a role when the man at the other end is going bonkers.
A DOT TO FINISH! What an anti-climax. A short ball outside off, Maxwell leaps and looks to pull but misses. He wants the bye but Stoinis says bye bye. AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 229/2!
Short and outside off, Stoinis jumps and punches it towards long off. Just a single.
Marcus Stoinis walks in now.

OUT! HIT WICKET OFF A WIDE! Bizarre scenes out there. Muzarabani bowls this miles outside off and Finch, in his attempt to reach that, slips and hits the stumps with his bat instead. The keeper behind spots that and starts to appeal but Finch is already walking. What a shame. Falls 4 short of what would have been a world record of the highest individual score in all T20 cricket.

DROPPED! 5th dropped catch, all of Finch. The skipper pulls this down to long on, backing away, the fielder charges in, dives forward but shells the catch. Two runs taken. Gayle's 175 in sight now for Finchy...
Outside off, punched down the ground through mid on for a couple.
Glenn Maxwell walks in with a big smile, at number 3, replacing Short.

OUT! Zimbabwe finally take a wicket. A length ball wide outside off, Short looks to swipe across the line but only gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air and Peter Moor takes it calmly. Short is furious with himself. Could not play a good innings. Had to play second fiddle throughout. Would have wanted to stay unbeaten and get that half century.
WIDE. Miles outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Outside off, Finch slashes hard and gets a thick inside edge which just misses the stumps. The keeper dives to his right and stops it. 21 from that over, Mpofu finishes with figures of 4-0-53-0.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
SIX! TONK! Another six. A length ball, Finch hits this high, very high but manages to clear Ryan Burl at long on!

SIX! HIGHEST INDIVIDUAL SCORE IN T20IS! Finch betters his own record. Had scored 156 against England in Southampton in 2013. Moves to 158 now. Full and outside off, Aaron backs away and flays this over cover.
FOUR! TOP EDGE! A length ball outside off, Finch slogs hard and gets a top edge over the keeper to the fence behind!
Full and wide outside off, Finch squeezes it through the covers for a couple.
WIDE. Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone. A fumble by the keeper allows the batsmen a single as well.
FOUR! FIRST EVER DOUBLE CENTURY STAND IN T20IS! A half tracker, pulled to the mid-wicket fence.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DROPPED BUT WHAT AN EFFORT! A length ball, Finch lofts this high and handsome towards long on. Tendai Chisoro watches the ball, seems like it will sail over but then he leaps, sticks out his left hand and manages to push the ball back in! Just a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.

DROPPED! 82, 113, 133 and 142! Move your luck Finchy, move your luck Finchy, from morning to night! Oh my word... Full and outside off, Finch pulls it straight to deep mid-wicket. The fielder dives but puts it down. A single taken.
HOWZZAT? Not out. A short ball outside off, Finch looks to pull but misses. There is an appeal for a caught behind but the umpire does not agree.
Blessing Muzarabani is back on. 2-0-22-0 so far.
Backs away and hammers it towards long on for a single. Not a bad over from the seamer - just 8 from it.
WELL BOWLED! Second dot on the trot! A yorker from Mpofu, AF can only dig it out to the bowler.
DOT BALL! Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
FOUR! What a shot. A short ball outside off, steep bounce, Finch counters that by getting on his toes and slaps it over cover for a boundary! Moves to 141 from 61 balls with his 14th four.

A short ball, Finch pulls this towards mid-wicket. The fielder is a bit lethargic in returning the ball and the skipper is back for the second. The throw is a bad one and Aaron gets back. A better throw would have ended this partnership which is now the BEST FOR ANY TEAM, FOR ANY WICKET.
Outside off, heaved down to long on for a single.
Chris Mpofu to bowl now. 2-0-24-0 so far.

DROPPED! On 82, then 113 and now on 133. Finch is on a roll and that is a massive understatement. Full and outside off, Finch backs away and looks to go big. Skies the ball high in the air and it is a chance. Ryan Burl comes charging in from cover , dives, gets to the ball but cannot hang on. Two runs taken. 21 from this over, 57 off the last 3!
FOUR! More short stuff. Finch pulls it over the man at short fine now. The stand is worth 182 from 95 balls.

FOUR! A long hop now, Finch heaves again and the ball goes off the inner half of the bat past short fine leg. Blessing Muzarabani runs, no, jogs, even the deep square leg fielder reaches the ball first, but after the ball crosses the ropes.
SIX! Oh dear.. that has gone out of Harare. A full toss, Finch takes full toll and heaves it miles over mid-wicket!
FOUR! THWACK! Best ever stand for Australia in T20Is, for any wicket. A short ball, again, Finch pulls it again. Over mid-wicket. Again. A boundary. Again. Yawn...
Full and outside off, Short looks to heave but gets a thick inside edge which goes past the stumps to short fine leg. A single taken.
Solomon Mire introduced.
DROPPED! Oh dear... going from bad to worse. Full and outside off, Finch drives it straight to cover where the fielder shells it. Two runs taken. 20 from the over, 36 from the last 2!

SIX! Another mistimed shot clears the ropes. Full and outside off, Finch leans and hammers it over long off. The fielder waits, waits and waits and then leaps, but in vain. Finch moves to 113 from 53 balls.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Short drives this through the covers and gets a boundary!
Full and outside off, Aaron gets across, looks to slog, slips but still manages to hit it past the bowler to long on for a single. FIRST EVER 150-RUN OPENING STAND FOR AUSTRALIA IN T20IS!
SIX! THUNDEROUS! Welcome back, mate! A long hop, outside off, Finch goes back and heaves it over long on!
John Nyumbu is back on.
CENTURY FOR FINCH! His second in T20Is. Gets it by working the ball towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total. 16 from the over, Burl has gone for 30 in his 2 overs!
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! A lollipop. A full toss to a batsman who is down the track, Short hits it long and high over mid-wicket!
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! First shot in anger from Short. Comes down the track and lofts it over long off. The fielder at the ropes leaps but in vain.
Ryan Burl is back on.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. Just the one boundary in his entire spell - 4-0-19-0 for Chisoro. What a performance.
SIX! THUMP! Another one clears the ropes. Finch backs away and hammers this with disdain over long off!
Full and outside off, Finch looks to paddle but misses. The keeper whips off the bails and appeals for a stumping but it is not taken upstairs.
Comes down the track and and pushes it towards long off for one.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Yorker on middle, dug out back to the bowler.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! A short ball, pulled over mid-wicket. There is a man in the deep, in fact two. Both are mere spectators.
A length ball down the leg side, AF tickles it straight to short fine leg.
The batsman plays the pull shot. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
A short ball outside off, Aaron looks to hook but misses.

DROPPED! Tough chance. A long hop, Finch clobbers it straight back. Chibhabha tries to avoid himself getting hurt but somehow, it turns out like he is going for the catch. Poor lad. The ball bursts through his fingers and goes to long on. Two runs taken. Luckily, the bowler is okay.
On middle, flicked away for one.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Backs a long way down the leg side, Chisoro follows him, darts a yorker, Finch still tries to go inside out but gets a thick bottom edge past the keeper. A single taken.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
On middle, defended back to the bowler.
Full toss outside leg, Short misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The keeper goes up in an appeal while Short looks for the single but the bowler quickly gets across to stop the run.
A short ball, on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single. Moves to 80 from 35 balls.
FOUR! THRASH! A length ball on middle, Finch backs away and clobbers it over the bowler. Long on dives to his left but the ball goes through!
A long hop again, pulled through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a late call to go for the second but eventually make it. 100-RUN STAND IS UP and we are not even halfway through yet.
Short and outside off, Short cuts it, just past a diving fielder from point. There is protection in the deep, hence just a run.
Not a bad idea to start with a slower ball, Finch pushes it wide of mid off and gets a quick single.
Another change. Chamu Chibhabha into the attack now.
Another dot ball. This is on middle, flicked straight to short  mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Another long hop, bammed through mid-wicket for one.
On middle and leg, sensible stuff from Short, playing second fiddle, works it with soft hands through square leg for a run. Just needs to give his captain the strike.
Outside off, steered straight to short third man.
Short and on off, pulled brutally to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single. 14 from Burl's opening over.
Ha ha! Some non-bashing cricket for a change. Aaron goes back and works it through square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Another one? Nope, just a yard short. Full and outside off, Finch gets down on a knee again and hammers it over the bowler, just wide of the man at long on.
SIX! THRASH! No mercy. Full on off, Finch gets down and slogs it over long on! Moves to 63 from 26 balls with his 4th six.
Comes down the track, is beaten comprehensively but somehow manages to steer it through the covers for a single.
Full on middle, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Ryan Burl to bowl as well.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Outside off, D'Arcy punches it to cover, wants a single but is sent back.
Down the leg side, helped through square leg for a couple.
Short and outside off, Short looks to cut but misses.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Tendai Chisoro to bowl now.

A short ball, Short looks to pull but mistimes the shot. It is uppish and lands just short of the fielder at short mid-wicket. 15 from the over means 35 off the last 2. Australia finish the Powerplay on 75/0! Finch has scored 56 of those...
On middle and leg, tickled through square leg for a single.
FOUR! No one moves. Only the scorecard runs. Short and outside off, Finch crunches it through the covers.
SIX! Another ugly heave. Half century for Finch and it has taken him just 22 balls. A length ball on middle, Finch heaves it over mid-wicket to register his fastest T20I fifty.
Outside off, Finch punches it towards mid off.
FOUR! Poor line, as if the scoring was not good enough. Down the leg side, fine leg is up. Finch tickles it past the fielder.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Short leans and punches it through the covers for a boundary! 20 from the over, Muzarabani's figures read 2-0-22-0!
Interesting. We have a slip in place now!!!
A length ball on middle, Short looks to swing but there is no feet movement. The ball goes past him to the keeper.
WIDE. The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
A short ball now, pulled away for a single.

SIX! 50 UP FOR AUSTRALIA IN 27 BALLS! And what a way to get it too. A length ball outside off, Finch backs away and looks to go over mid off. He ends up skewing it but such is his luck that it travels over cover!
FOUR! TAKE THAT! On a length again, outside off, Finch just stays leg side of the ball and clobbers it over mid off.

FOUR LEG BYES! Seems like Lady Luck is shining on Australia. A lovely delivery, landing the ball on a length, coming back in, Finch looks to tuck it away but is done in by the bounce. The ball goes off the pads through the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence!
Blessing Muzarabani is back on.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover for a quick one.
On middle and leg, tucked through square leg for one.
Punches it through mid off for a run.
Outside off, hammered straight to mid off.
SIX! Ugly but effective. On a length outside off, Finch looks to go straight, but the bat twists in his hand a bit. Still, the connection is good enough to clear wide long on.
Short and outside off, Finch slashes but misses.
Chris Mpofu into the attack now.

FOUR! Edged away! Unlucky bowler. Short and outside off, Short throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge through the vacant slip cordon to third man! 17 from the Nyumbu over, whose figures read 2-0-24-0!
Full and outside off, Short thinks about going big but then decides to block it.
Outside off, played through point for a run.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries! Short and outside off, Finch plays that uppishly and just gets it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary!
FOUR! On the pads now, darted in, Finch calmly flicks it over mid-wicket and gets consecutive boundaries!
FOUR! SPANKED! Tossed up outside off, Finch backs away and lofts it straight back over the bowler for a boundary!
The batsman does well to stand tall and play that short delivery. They pick up a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Finch backs away and punches it through the covers for a boundary!
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Short and wide outside off, Short slashes but misses.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Blessing Muzarabani to bowl from the other end.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.

Huge, huge appeal for LBW! Not given! How close was that? Seemed pretty close to the naked eye. Very full, on middle and leg, DAS played all over it as he looked to flick and missed the ball. Was hit in front and the bowler appealed but it was turned down. There was a bit of drama as well as the non-striker wanted the single but Short was not sure where the ball was. A yes-yes and a no-no situation occurred while the fielding team was more interested in appealing and no one actually looked where the ball was going. Eventually the single was completed and a leg bye was signalled.
Short and outside off, D'Arcy cuts it through the covers and gets back for a second. A better throw from the fielder could have had the batsman in trouble at the striker's end.
Punches this down to long on for a run.
Full and around off, defended watchfully for a quick run.
Off the mark straightaway. Around off, a bit of a flight, Finch just taps it towards long on and crosses over for a single.
The players are out in the middle! We are not far from the start. D'Arcy Short and Aaron Finch are the openers while off spinner John Nyumbu will bowl first up. Short will take strike. Here we go!!!

Aussie skipper, Aaron Finch admits that he too wanted to bowl first but now wants to put a good total on the board. He too agrees that there will not be a big difference in the pitch today and it is just a matter of bowling in the right areas. Also says that it will be a good 40-over wicket. Says that there will be no team changes today as he wants the players to understand their roles and also be prepared to do well when pressure comes.

Zimbabwe skipper, Hamilton Masakadza says that there seems to be a little bit of moisture on the wicket hence the decision. Feels the match will last only three hours, so the pitch should not change that much and be pretty good. Admits that they have got a very depleted squad but also hopes that the guys in the squad put their hand up. Wants to forget what happened against Pakistan and start afresh today. Informs that Kyle Jarvis is out of the series due to a fractured finger and Chris Mpofu takes his place today.
TOSS TIME. Hamilton Masakadza tosses the coin, tails is the call from Aaron Finch, but it is a Head. ZIMBABWE WILL CHASE.

PITCH REPORT - Dirk Viljoen observes the track and sees that is devoid of grass totally. This is the one where both the games were played and hence there are a few cracks on offer. Also, seems like it has not been watered enough because maybe Zimbabwe do not want enough moisture. Looks like a bat first pitch according to him but he also feels that the captain winning the toss will be tempted to bowl because the pitch becomes a batting beauty in the afternoon.

WEATHER - It might be raining in some parts of the world. Warnings of heavy floods could be issued as well. But if you are in Harare, you need not bother or worry. Because it is bright and sunny without a chance of rain!!!

2 matches done, both one-sided contests. Zimbabwe were on the wrong side of one while Pakistan faced the brunt of the other. Will we see some sort of a contest today? Let us hope so. Hello and a warm welcome to the third match of the tri-series between Zimbabwe and Australia in Harare.
